regions.today: Today will be dry, and after a mostly cloudy start, hazy sunny spells will develop as the day goes on. Highest temperatures of 17 to 21 degrees with a light to moderate westerly wind.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be dry with clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 12 degrees with light and variable winds.
regions.tomorrow: Mostly dry tomorrow with spells of hazy sunshine. Cloud will build at times, bringing a chance of the odd spot of drizzle. Highest temperatures of 15 to 19 degrees, coolest near the east coast due to a light to moderate easterly breeze.
regions.solar_uv: High or Moderate on Saturday and Sunday.
